sql.process.getAllForCompany: select process.id, process.process_name as name, company_process.company_id from flow.company_process inner join flow.process on process.id = company_process.process_id where company_id = :companyId;
sql.process.get: select process.id, process.process_name as name, company_process.company_id from flow.company_process inner join flow.process on process.id = company_process.process_id where company_id = :companyId and process_id = :processId;
